note: Provides a Views style plugin 'geojson' (outputs a FeatureCollection) and a 'geojson_export' display (extends RestExport, defaults style to geojson). Style option data_source.value selects geometry: latlon (latitude+longitude fields), geofield, geolocation, or wkt; plus id_field/name_field/description_field; other fields become feature properties. Bounding box: contextual argument views_geojson_bbox_argument + argument-default BBoxQuery (reads a bbox query param). Hook hook_geojson_view_alter. Uses itamair/geophp. No settings page. Medium/hard inspect/build a geojson_export display / geojson style on real views (vgj_known_view / vgj_task_view).

evals.prompt: How do I output a Drupal View as GeoJSON for a Leaflet map using Views GeoJSON? Which Views style or display do I use?
evals.expected_output: Add a 'GeoJSON export' display (plugin geojson_export) to your view, or set the display's style to 'GeoJSON' (style id geojson); it serializes rows into a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.

evals.prompt: In the Views GeoJSON style settings, what data-source options can I choose to get each feature's geometry, and how do I set a feature's id/name/description?
evals.expected_output: data_source can be latlon (a latitude + longitude field), geofield, geolocation, or wkt. Set id_field, name_field and description_field for the feature id/name/description; other fields become feature properties.

evals.prompt: Using Views GeoJSON, how do I return only the features inside the current map viewport (bounding box)?
evals.expected_output: Add the 'Bounding box' contextual filter (views_geojson_bbox_argument) and provide its default from the 'bbox' query parameter (argument-default BBoxQuery); the client passes ?bbox=minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat as the map moves.

evals.prompt: On this site the View 'vgj_known_view' has a GeoJSON export display. Inspect the view: which data source (geometry source) is the GeoJSON style configured to use?
evals.expected_output: The GeoJSON style uses the 'latlon' data source (a latitude field field_lat and longitude field field_lon). Read views.view.vgj_known_view display geojson_1 style.options.data_source.value.

evals.prompt: The View 'vgj_task_view' only has a default display. Add a GeoJSON export display (so the view can serve GeoJSON) and save the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: Add a display with display_plugin 'geojson_export' (or a display whose style type is 'geojson') to vgj_task_view and save. verify checks the view has such a GeoJSON-outputting display.
